name: Jiuzhaigou Valley Scenic and Historic Interest Area
description: Jiuzhaigou is a long, forested valley in the Min Mountains of northern Sichuan, on the edge of the Tibetan Plateau. Snow-capped peaks rise above it, and its colorful lakes and layered waterfalls tumble through the trees. The reserve covers 72,000 hectares and shelters around 140 bird species, along with giant pandas and Sichuan takins.
